text:
deploy-bot: Promotion to canary failed for release v2026.03.20 (job: release/canary-promote) — ERROR: helm values checksum mismatch, aborting rollout
ci-bot: build logs: `helm template` step produced different rendered values than last-promoted tag. Snippet: `expected checksum: 0x5a2b, actual: 0x7c9d`
aj: Ugh. Which chart changed? Was there a values patch in the PR?
maria: PR #4827 touched infra/helm/values/canary.yaml — small change to autoscaling thresholds. I thought CI would detect but checksum compares entire rendered manifest.
samir: Can we pin the canary image tag and re-run? The change looks safe but we can't promote until the checks align.
lina: Quick triage: if rendered manifests differ because of a non-deterministic field (timestamp, generated name), we should fix the rendering or relax the checksum for that field. Do we have the diff?
maria: Diff (rendered):
```
- autoscaling:
-   minReplicas: 2
+ autoscaling:
+   minReplicas: 3
```
That was intentional from the PR.
aj: So the checksum is correct. CI is doing its job. We need a release decision: hold, rollback, or manual promote after pinning.
release-manager: Change window is until 18:00 PT today. We have one hour. If canary can't promote we should roll back the release branch to the last promoted commit and re-run.
samir: Rollback to tag `v2026.03.19-rc3` would restore previous values. I'm +1 for rollback to keep the canary on schedule; we can re-open the PR for autoscaling bump and re-queue a controlled rollout.
lina: Agree. But note: we should make the helm checksum more focused (ignore autoscaling.minReplicas) or switch to a manifest-level semantic check. Filed infra ticket INFRA-1142.
aj: I'll start the rollback. Command I'll run: `./scripts/promote.sh --to-tag v2026.03.19-rc3 --env canary` and then re-trigger CI.
maria: Thanks. I'll revert the change in the release branch and open a follow-up PR to reintroduce the autoscaling bump behind a feature toggle.
ci-bot: rollback job queued: release/rollback-to-v2026.03.19-rc3 (job id: 672113)
deploy-bot: Canary rollback started. Expected completion ~5m. Notifying oncall.
release-manager: Good call. After rollback, please attach logs to the incident and mark this as a release-blocker. We'll review the policy for helm checks in tomorrow's postmortem. :thumbsup:
